blind.description: An ornate classic wooden bedside commode or chest of three drawers. It features a curved serpentine front, three pull drawers with decorative brass or gold-coloured swing handles and escutcheons, corner baluster-style pillar carvings, moulded top rim, and carved bracket feet. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous, finished in warm reddish brown wood lacquer with brass metallic details.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top with a gentle serpentine curved edge along the front and straight sides and back.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 ft tall (reaching just below the waist/hip of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 ft wide.
